Most comprehensive air and gas treatment portfolio: From separators and regenerative and adsorption dryers to refrigerated dryers, BAUER covers all air and gas purity requirements in accordance with DIN ISO 8573-1. Global market leadership & service expertise: BAUER is the global market standard in high- and medium-pressure applications across nearly all segments – with a 70% market share in breathing air systems and an undisputed leading position in industrial applications, supported by a global service network. What is the G22 series used for in helium applications? The G22 series comprises air-cooled high-pressure compressors for industrial helium compression. It is used wherever helium needs to be reliably compressed from atmospheric pressure to high final pressures or reprocessed within recovery systems, for example in industrial processes, research facilities, test benches and gas recovery plants. What performance ranges does the G22 series cover for helium? Depending on the configuration, the high-pressure versions of the G22 series achieve final pressures of up to 350 bar. The effective delivery rates range from approximately 620 to 1,500 litres per minute, depending on the model. This makes the series suitable for both compact helium applications and high-capacity recovery and supply systems. How are the G22 high-pressure compressors controlled and monitored? The compressors are equipped with the B-CONTROL MICRO control system.

Falls die Lieferung am vereinbarten Termin aus Gründen, die der Vertragspartner zu verant- worten hat, nicht stattfinden kann, gerät dieser in Annahmeverzug. Spätestens zu diesem Zeit- punkt gehen Gefahr und Kosten auf den Vertragspartner über. Darüber hinaus ist Bauer- Poseidon berechtigt, den Vertragsgegenstand nach ihrer Wahl zu versenden oder in beliebiger Weise im Namen und auf Rechnung des Vertragspartners einzulagern. Mit diesem Zeitpunkt gilt der Vertragsgegenstand als in jeder Hinsicht vertragsgemäß geliefert. Der Vertragspartner ist verpflichtet, die für den Fall der Lieferung fälligen oder durch die Lieferung bedingten Zahlungen unverzüglich zu leisten.

Liegt dem Geschäft ein Werkvertrag zu Grunde, so kommt der Vertragspartner mit der Ab- nahme des Werks in Verzug, wenn er nicht innerhalb einer Woche nach Übergabe, Fertigstel- lungsanzeige oder Rechnungsstellung die Abnahme vornimmt.

Im Falle des Vertragsrücktrittes kann Bauer-Poseidon vom Vertragspartner eine nicht dem richterlichen Mäßigungsrecht unterliegende Zahlung in Höhe von 20% des Bruttowerklohnes als Entschädigung begehren; darüber hinausgehende Schadenersatzansprüche gegen den Ver- tragspartner bleiben hiervon unberührt.

Kompressorsteuerung B-CONTROL SMART Die B-CONTROL SMART ist eine leistungsstarke Kompressorsteuerung mit erweitertem Funktionsumfang, viel Speicher und IoT-Konnektivität via B-CLOUD. Sie unterstützt den Verbundbetrieb und bietet hohe Performance für anspruchsvolle Anwendungen. Wahlweise mit 3,5" Farbdisplay oder 7" Touchscreen ermöglicht sie intuitive Bedienung und sicheren Fernzugriff – eine zukunftssichere Lösung. System design The directly coupled compressor units are equipped with vibration dampers and are suitable for installation without a special foundation. The air-cooled compressor is designed for efficient heat dissipation and easy maintenance. The direct coupling provides reliable, low-maintenance power transmission between the electric motor and compressor. The automatic condensate drain ensures continuous operation by efficiently removing condensate. Compressor block Our air-cooled compressor blocks come equipped with intercoolers, an aftercooler, an oil and water separator after each compression stage, and a reliable forced-feed oil lubrication system. They provide the foundation for fully automated systems designed to compress air and gases at either atmospheric or elevated intake pressures. Oversized coolers and ribbed cylinders ensure effective heat dissipation. Ultra-fine oil filters, extended maintenance intervals, and dynamically balanced drive systems contribute to high efficiency, reliability, and smooth, low-vibration performance.

Available in the App Store (iOS) and on GooglePlay (Android). The new B-APP turns your smartphone into a ­compressor control unit. B-CLOUD NEW! With the BAUER B-CLOUD you always have everything in view. One look at the B-APP or the B-CLOUD browser app is enough and all important information is available to you. Whether you want to check the status of your equipment or need the help of our service technicians in case of a problem, BAUER and the B-CLOUD will support you. The B-APP reports malfunctions with a machine diagnosis in plain text so that you know immediately where the problem lies. In addition, the B-CLOUD informs you regularly about upcoming maintenance work and, if desired, networks with your BAUER-authorized service partner. The archiving of all important data and the automated creation of monthly reports also works completely stress-free via the B-CLOUD. At present, the following POSEIDON EDITION BAUER systems are B-CLOUD ready: › PE-VE DATA SECURITY An integral part of B-CLOUD2 involves ensuring the security of compressor systems and the data they transmit.
